## Sequence rarefaction

```{r}
read_matrix <- function(data, taxa_level){
  rm <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, !!sym(taxa_level)) %>%
    summarize(reads=sum(set_read_count)) %>%
    ungroup()

  rm <- as.data.frame(pivot_wider(data=rm,
                    names_from = sample_ID,
                    values_from = reads,
                    values_fill = list(reads=0)))

  return(rm)

}

plot_rarecurve_plot <- function(data, taxa_level){
  read_counts <- read_matrix(data, taxa_level)
  
  rarecurve_data <- read_counts[,-1]
  rownames(rarecurve_data) <- read_counts[[taxa_level]]

  rarecurve <-  rarecurve(t(rarecurve_data), step = 500, 
                          label=FALSE, cex=0.2, tidy = TRUE)
  
  colnames(rarecurve) <- c("Site", "Sample", "Taxa_level")
  rarecurve$cat <- ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", as.character(rarecurve$Site)), "2020-2021", "2024-2025")
  
  pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(6,1)]

  plot <- ggplot(data=rarecurve, aes(x=Sample, y=Taxa_level, color=cat)) +
  geom_point(size=0.1) +
    scale_color_manual(values=pal) +
  theme_bw() +
    facet_grid(~cat) +
  labs(x="Sequences",
       y="Species") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r}
fonts <- theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial", size=25),
    plot.title = element_text(family = "Arial", size=25, face = "bold", hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5))
```

## Viral read proportions

```{r}
summarize_viral_reads <- function(data){
  data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID) %>%
    summarize(total_mapped=sum(set_read_count),
              total_reads=first(filtered_reads_in_sample),
              viral_reads_percentage=(total_mapped/total_reads)*100,
              .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(Year_cat=ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_ID), 
                          "2020-2021", "2024-2025"))
}
```

```{r}
pal <- park_palette("DeathValley")[c(6,1)]
#plot viral read proportion of all samples
plot_vread_percentage_all <- function(data){
  mean_val <- round(mean(data$viral_reads_percentage),3)
  median_val <- round(median(data$viral_reads_percentage),3)
  ggplot(data=data, aes(x="",y=viral_reads_percentage, fill=Year_cat)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Percentage",
         x="",
         title="Percentage of reads \naligned to viral genomes") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
          title = element_text(size=10),
          legend.position = "none") + 
    facet_grid(~Year_cat)+
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) 

}


#plot number of viral reads for all samples
plot_vread_number_all <- function(data){
  mean_val <- format(mean(data$total_mapped), 
                        scientific = T, digits = 6)
  median_val <- format(median(data$total_mapped), 
                          scientific =T, digits=6)
  
  ggplot(data=data, aes(x="",y=total_mapped, fill=Year_cat)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=pal) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "Reads aligned to viral genomes",
         x="",
    title="Number of viral reads") +
    facet_grid(~Year_cat)+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
          title = element_text(size=10),
          legend.position = "none")
}

```

```{r}
v_reads_human <- summarize_viral_reads(esviritu_human)
v_reads_human_ANI90 <- summarize_viral_reads(esviritu_human_ANI90)

v_reads_all <- summarize_viral_reads(esviritu_res)
v_reads_all_ANI90 <- summarize_viral_reads(esviritu_res_ANI90)
```


```{r}
save_v_reads_plot <- function(data, variable, filtered=FALSE){
    
  plot <- plot_grid(plot_vread_percentage_all(data),
            plot_vread_number_all(data))
  
    if(filtered==FALSE){
      plot_name <- paste0("v_reads_", variable, "_years.jpg")
    } else{
      plot_name <- paste0("species_pie_", variable, "_years_ANI90.jpg")
    }
  
  ggsave(plot, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Supplementary_figures",plot_name), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
}
```

```{r}
save_v_reads_plot(v_reads_human, "human")
save_v_reads_plot(v_reads_human_ANI90, "human", filtered=TRUE)

save_v_reads_plot(v_reads_all, "all")
save_v_reads_plot(v_reads_all_ANI90, "all", filtered=TRUE)

```


## Genome coverage categories

```{r}
calc_coverage_cats <- function(data){
  data %>%
  mutate(coverage = covered_bases/Asm_length) %>%
  mutate(cov_category = case_when(
    coverage >= 0.8 ~ "Over 80%",
    coverage < 0.8 & coverage >= 0.5 ~ "50% to 80%",
    coverage < 0.5 & coverage >= 0.1 ~ "10% to 50%",
    TRUE ~ "< 10%"
  ))
}

calc_coverage_cats_years <- function(data){
  data %>%
  mutate(Year_cat = ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_ID), 
                          "2020-2021", "2024-2025")) %>%
  group_by(Year_cat) %>%
  mutate(coverage = covered_bases/Asm_length) %>%
  mutate(cov_category = case_when(
    coverage >= 0.8 ~ "Over 80%",
    coverage < 0.8 & coverage >= 0.5 ~ "50% to 80%",
    coverage < 0.5 & coverage >= 0.1 ~ "10% to 50%",
    TRUE ~ "< 10%"
  ))
}


```

```{r}
plot_coverage_cat <- function(data, years=FALSE){

  if (years==FALSE){
    cols <- c("#fbb373", "#faa050", "#e19048", "#af7038")
  
  plot_data <- calc_coverage_cats(data) %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, cov_category) %>%
    summarize(seqs = n_distinct(Accession)) %>%
    group_by(cov_category) %>%
    mutate(cov_category = factor(cov_category, levels = c("< 10%",
                                                        "10% to 50%",
                                                        "50% to 80%",
                                                        "Over 80%")))

  plot <- ggplot(data=plot_data, aes(x=cov_category, y=seqs, fill = cov_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "grey20", draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) +

  #xlim(c(0,150)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "# virus references\nwith coverage level per sample",
       x = "Genome/segment coverage") +
  theme(legend.position = "Off",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        strip.text = element_text(size=10))
  
  return(plot)
  } else{
    cols_21 <- c("#a8a1c4", "#7468a1","#625595", "#514289")
    cols_24 <- c("#c97274","#b23539", "#8e2a2e", "#6b2022")
    
    plot_data <- calc_coverage_cats_years(data) %>%
      group_by(Year_cat, sample_ID, cov_category) %>%
      summarize(seqs = n_distinct(Accession)) %>%
      group_by(cov_category) %>%
      mutate(cov_category = factor(cov_category, levels = c("< 10%",
                                                        "10% to 50%",
                                                        "50% to 80%",
                                                        "Over 80%")))
    
    plot_data$cat_facet <- paste(plot_data$cov_category, plot_data$Year_cat, sep = "_")


  plot <- ggplot(data=plot_data, aes(x=cov_category, y=seqs, fill = cat_facet)) +
  geom_boxplot(color = "grey20") +
  #xlim(c(0,150)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "# virus references\nwith coverage level per sample",
       x = "Genome/segment coverage") +
  facet_grid(~Year_cat)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    setNames(cols_21, paste(c("< 10%","10% to 50%","50% to 80%","Over 80%"), "2020-2021", sep = "_")),
    setNames(cols_24, paste(c("< 10%","10% to 50%","50% to 80%","Over 80%"), "2024-2025", sep = "_"))
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    setNames(cols_21, paste(c("< 10%","10% to 50%","50% to 80%","Over 80%"), "2020-2021", sep = "_")),
    setNames(cols_24, paste(c("< 10%","10% to 50%","50% to 80%","Over 80%"), "2024-2025", sep = "_"))
  )) +
  theme(legend.position = "Off",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        strip.text = element_text(size=10))
  
  return(plot)
  }
}
```


```{r}
save_cov_cat_plot <- function(data, variable, filtered=FALSE){
    
  plot <- plot_coverage_cat(data, years=TRUE)
  
    if(filtered==FALSE){
      plot_name <- paste0("cov_cat_", variable, "_years.jpg")
    } else{
      plot_name <- paste0("cov_cat_", variable, "_years_ANI90.jpg")
    }
  
  ggsave(plot, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Supplementary_figures",plot_name), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
}
```


```{r}
save_cov_cat_plot(esviritu_human, "human")
save_cov_cat_plot(esviritu_human_ANI90, "human", filtered=TRUE)

save_cov_cat_plot(esviritu_res, "all")
save_cov_cat_plot(esviritu_res_ANI90, "all", filtered=TRUE)
```
